baseline.actual_cublas_vs_cublasLt_API_baseline: UNRESOLVED: kernel symbol alone does not identify frontend API; accepted CUDA/NVTX trace did not explicitly trace cuBLAS API calls. No proof baseline already cublasLt.

official_minimal_variable.scope: Process-global ATen context, not GPU-system-global clocks/power. Set once within isolated worker before model engine, compile and Graph capture. Child process re-exec/inheritance must be explicit; environment alternative TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_CUBLASLT=1 restricted to worker env can seed it.
official_minimal_variable.effect: Preference only, library fallback explicitly allowed. Could affect ATen mm/addmm when supported. Does not force Inductor-generated Triton/CUTLASS kernels. Existing Graph kernels remain unchanged after capture, so never toggle a captured engine to simulate backend counterfactual.

bounded_optional_test.question: Does one fresh isolated strong-compiled cublaslt-preferred engine change actual Dense kernels and reduce same-input B1/B2 generate cost relative to accepted native path?
minimum_prerequisites: Record queried preferred backend in actual model worker, not just dispatcher
Set before compile/capture, independent private compile/cache/output
Preserve BF16, original inputs/sampling; compare exact tokens and existing logprob sensitivity criteria as observations
Record generated ATen versus generated-kernel calls and actual Dense kernel symbols/grid per mode
Separate alternate software path from accepted native timing, interleave same-length repetitions if performance is claimed
Maintain resource/ImageLab/Graph/backend qualification; no global environment edits
reject_or_stop_optional_branch_if: Actual Dense kernels unchanged: label NO_OBSERVED_PATH_EFFECT, do not expand parameter sweep
Unknown weak fallback, missing identity, unsafe resource use
Numerical or Graph changes invalidate strict causal performance comparison; preserve descriptive result only
bounded_optional_test.not_a_mem_vs_sm_independent_control: Changing library may change tile, memory scheduling, computation and launch together; can test software choice opportunity but alone does not causally separate memory from SM limitations.

other_options.reason: Only registered non-default BF16 CUDA backend in dispatch; runtime predicate requires device capability family100. RTX4080 is SM89.
For this unquantized dispatch, names absent from _FLASHINFER_BF16_BACKENDS resolve to default F.linear. Broad accepted config literal list includes quantized and other-platform methods.
Changes compile/autotune and potentially workspace/kernel implementation; current evidence does not establish an unabsorbed performance problem. More invasive than one library preference variable.

recommendation: A single cublaslt-preference diagnostic is technically credible only if owner chooses it and verifies actual path change; do not assume speedup or run default/cublas/cublaslt/autotune matrix. Strong libraries already absorb ordinary BF16 GEMV/GEMM optimization; residual opportunity remains unproven.
